opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C not open to undergraduate/Master's students.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be a member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society who are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be a member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project producing results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a specific lecture to up to about £1,000 for a session; several thousand pounds as major sponsor (recent major sponsorship £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members organising genetic-themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of one-off genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of the meeting.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Support for public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members, for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings, including new Special Interest Groups.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they care for; priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.
